safety_line: Bites are a nuisance and can itch for days; no disease is known to spread through bed bug bites. See a doctor if a bite site looks infected.
traits: Apple-seed sized, flat, reddish-brown; swells and reddens after feeding
Hides in mattress seams, frame joints, and headboard cracks
Pepper-like dark fecal spotting along seams
Bites appear in lines or clusters, often on arms and shoulders

look_alikes.difference: Bed bugs and bat bugs look nearly identical; bat bug infestations trace back to a bat roost (attic, soffit) rather than bedrooms.
look_alikes.next_photo: A wide shot of where you found it (bedroom vs. attic/soffit near a bat roost).

copy.what_it_means: They follow luggage and furniture, not filth — five-star hotels get them too, and a clean home is not immune. DIY sprays tend to scatter them into neighboring rooms, so an inspection first, then targeted treatment, works far better.
copy.fact: They follow luggage and furniture, not filth — five-star hotels get them too. Clean homes are not immune.
